title: From Optimizing Engagement to Measuring Value
models_tested: Latent Variable Model (LVM) based on a Bayesian network
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of the study.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It proposes a framework to measure a latent construct of 'value' from user engagement signals (clicks, likes, etc.) in a recommendation system.
